notes.drawing: Phosphor's calendar (calendar-blank) with a clock in the body under the header line, centred at (128, 152) where calendar-check and calendar-plus centre their glyphs. Phosphor's clock at radius 40, hands up and right, 18 long. That leaves 6 units between the hands' caps and the ring and 8 between the ring and the header line or the bottom: tighter than Phosphor's 16, but shorter hands (14, as first sketched) read as a pie slice at 24 px, not as hands.
notes.bold: Maintainer: don't let the clock get too thick in bold. The frame is bold (24; rings 24 to 52 as in calendar-bold); the clock keeps the regular stroke (16, a nested stroke-width the build keeps) at radius 38 with 18-unit hands, so it stays 6 clear of the header line and the bottom. Tried: everything at 24 (ring and hands close into a disc with a notch), the ring at 20 with hands at 16 (the hands still blob); the regular-stroke clock is the only one that still reads as a clock at 16 px.
